title_sq: Shitet apartament 3+1+2 + post parkimi tek Rruga e Kosovareve
description_sq:
Shitet Apartament 3+1+2 dhe post parkimi tek pallati Orion tek rruga kosovareve, me pamje nga Fushat e Parkut Olimbik.
Siperfaqe apartamentit eshte 134.7 m2 total nga te cilat 117.3 m2 jane siperfaqe neto. Apartamenti eshte i arreduar me arkitekt duke shfrytezuar te gjithe hapsiren e apartamentit ne menyre funksionale. Apartamenti ka mobilim, sistem kondicionimi punime me kuartz cka tregon nje investim cilesore. Apartamenti ka gardarobe te vecuar ne njeren nga dhomat. 
Apartamenti disponon nje post parkimi ne katin -2 te perfshire ne cmim. 
Apartamenti shitet: 565.000 Euro.
title_en: 3+1+2 apartment for sale + parking post at Rruga e Kosovareve
description_en: Apartment 3+1+2 for sale and parking post at the Orion palace on Kosovareve Street, with a view of the Olympic Park Fields. The surface of the apartment is 134.7 m2 in total, of which 117.3 m2 are net surface. The apartment is furnished with an architect, using all the space of the apartment in a functional way. The apartment has furniture, air conditioning system and quartz work, which shows a quality investment. The apartment has a separate wardrobe in one of the rooms. The apartment has a parking space on the -2nd floor included in the price. The apartment is for sale: 565,000 Euros.
